arcs.title: The Briefcase
arcs.summary: Day 3: The briefcase opened briefly at 11:43 a.m. Three witnesses disagree on what they saw; one described a colour without a name. The clerk's report has been confiscated; the clerk is cheerful. The hum briefly resolved to a chord before returning. Day 4 should move toward identification — perhaps Wrobel's confiscated reports are partially leaked, or a fourth party surfaces with a competing and unexpectedly specific claim of ownership, or someone outside the Ministry who has no reason to know about the briefcase asks after it by name.
